summary: Iteration 10 frontend-only verification. Homepage now renders EIGHT blog cards with correct data-testids and icon-only headers (0 in each card). All 3 new routes (/blog/bachelor-degree-attestation, /blog/saudi-medical-check, /blog/domestic-workers-recruitment) render correct Arabic titles, 6 h2 body sections each, blogpost-cta, blogpost-back, 2 related posts, and inject BOTH Article + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD into (medical-check keywords contain GAMCA/جيمكا). sitemap.xml served 200 with exactly 16 URLs including the 3 new saudivisajo.com blog URLs; llms.txt served with 8 blog article links (6 required present). Regression: 5 pre-existing blog posts, 4 service pages, 3 legal pages and 404 all render correct h1s; header nav is dark (rgba(1,59,30,0.8)) on inner pages and white (rgba(255,255,255,0.85)) on home hero; marquee track animating (x -6131 -> -6234); mobile menu opens via menu-open-btn and closes via menu-close-btn. Card click, related-post nav and back-to-blog nav all work. Zero console errors on every tested route. Production build exit 0 with build/_redirects present. No horizontal overflow at 1440/768/390.

issues: Grid class is 'grid md:grid-cols-3' so at 768px it jumps straight to 3 columns (~230px wide cards) instead of the expected 2-column reflow. Suggest 'grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3' for a 3->2->1 progression. Cosmetic only, no overflow.

action_items: Optional: change homepage blog grid to sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 so tablet (768px) shows 2 columns instead of 3 narrow cards.
critical_code_review_comments: BlogPost.jsx injects JSON-LD client-side only; crawlers without JS execution (and the static build HTML) will not see Article/BreadcrumbList schema. Consider prerender/react-snap or static HTML injection if SEO schema pickup by non-JS crawlers matters.
Article JSON-LD omits 'image' even though some BLOG entries have an image field; Google prefers an image property for Article rich results.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 10 checks pass. Only open item is the cosmetic 768px blog grid column count (md:grid-cols-3). Useful testids: blog-card-{slug}, blog-post-{slug}, blogpost-cta, blogpost-back, related-{slug}, menu-open-btn, menu-close-btn, mobile-menu, marquee-section + .marquee-track. Mobile menu overlay covers the open button, so always close with menu-close-btn.
